question: In Linear: Assign to Leo Park the Checkout project issue that has a GitHub pull request Leo attached. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
Done ✅ There was one — **WEB-6 "Lazy-load payment icons"** (in the Checkout project) has the GitHub PR Leo attached: [PR #484 "Lazy-load icons"](https://github.com/northwind/web/pull/484). It was assigned to Sam Rivera, so I reassigned it to Leo Park.

Note: the Checkout epic itself (WEB-5) had no PR attached — the only issue in the project with a Leo-attached PR was WEB-6.
